output.question: Who is AWS's CTO?
output.answer: AWS’s chief AI and technology officer is Matt Wood, as identified in Amazon’s September 17, 2026 announcement. This is distinct from Werner Vogels, whose official title is CTO of Amazon.com.

key_facts.fact: Amazon identifies Matt Wood as AWS Chief AI and Technology Officer.
AWS’s official biography identifies Werner Vogels as CTO of Amazon.com, rather than AWS.

passages.quote: At the AWS Global Meeting on September 17, AWS Chief AI and Technology Officer Matt Wood laid out a vision
Dr. Werner Vogels, VP & CTO at Amazon.com

caveats: Matt Wood’s full published title is Chief AI and Technology Officer, not simply CTO.
The AWS biography of Werner Vogels does not display a publication date.
